program.name: Yoga Core 35
program.subject: Yoga
program.blurb: Yoga with a strong middle: core poses, then standing poses or backbends.
program.about: Yoga that works the core hard. Sun salutations lead into boat, plank, dolphin and tiger shapes; then standing poses one day and backbends the next, with a rest to close. They alternate. Level II brings harder poses and Level III holds them longer.
